generationPolicy.money: Same 20–2400 range independently hashed for every label; no label-specific amount selection. Amount-only variants removed.
generationPolicy.style: Controlled Chinese purchase, payment and receipt grammar; domain contexts; bounded style families per seed.
generationPolicy.difficulty: easy/normal are ordinary ledger expressions. Hard samples distinguish purpose/direction or keep actual usage under family/travel scenes.
generationPolicy.provenance: All authored records retain seedText/source and original v1 ID where available. V1 files preserved unchanged.

reviewPolicy.seedAudit: Ambiguous device/service, financial subtype and overlapping housing fee seeds rejected, including all derived variants.
reviewPolicy.recordAudit: Separate lexical/time/direction checks plus normalized and near duplicate deletion; generation acceptance is not unconditional.
reviewPolicy.templateAudit: One example per seed/pattern family; verbose bookkeeping scaffolds and implausible split-payment routine purchases rejected.
reviewPolicy.nearDuplicate: NFKC normalized SequenceMatcher >=0.965 within concept groups is deleted; seed similarities >=0.76 are grouped before split.
reviewPolicy.split: Whole groups only. Known minimal-pair object families are unioned across labels before class-aware split.

limitations: Synthetic compositional data, not independently collected real user transactions.
Seed and sentence review uses controlled grammar and deterministic rules; no human corpus audit or trained-model validation claimed.
Lexical similarity cannot prove absence of every semantic paraphrase; known concepts and explicit minimal pairs are grouped conservatively.
